figures.title: Geometry, domain, and sampling layout
figures.caption: Production domain Lin=2D, Lout=8D with heated tube/fins, wake probes, and high-cadence sampling used for force, heat-transfer, POD, and coherence analyses.

figures.title: Cd(t), Cl(t), and PSD(Cl)
figures.caption: Production-window force histories and lift spectrum show the established periodic regime with shedding near St=0.154 and a strong second-harmonic/adjacent-peak component.

figures.title: Heat balance and Nusselt closure
figures.caption: Wall-integrated and air-side heat rates close within about one percent, while Nu_EB and wall-side Nu provide independent, consistent heat-transfer estimates.

figures.title: Mean and RMS Nu(theta,z) on the tube
figures.caption: Mean and RMS maps expose the circumferential/spanwise organization of tube heat transfer and identify where unsteady shedding modulates local Nu.

figures.title: Phase-averaged Nu(theta)
figures.caption: Eight phase-conditioned tube profiles show how the circumferential heat-transfer peak moves and changes intensity over the shedding cycle.

figures.title: Nu_local(x) on fins
figures.caption: Mean, RMS, and lift-coherence profiles on the two heated fin surfaces identify streamwise regions actively coupled to vortex shedding.

figures.title: POD energy and mode 1/2 maps
figures.caption: The first two modes form the dominant shedding pair in velocity and temperature; the spatial mode maps show the coherent wake/thermal structures.

figures.title: EPOD / Cl-correlated thermal structure
figures.caption: EPOD regression fields and single-frequency coherent amplitudes expose the midspan thermal structures correlated with lift and heat-transfer metrics.

figures.title: Coherence Cl <-> local Nu
figures.caption: Spatial coherence maps reveal localized fundamental coupling and nearly global second-harmonic organization of the local heat-transfer response.

figures.title: Summary mechanism schematic
figures.caption: Conceptual mechanism distilled from the production run: shedding phase drives coherent wake probes, local tube/fin Nu redistribution, and a delayed fin-dominated heat-transfer response while maintaining global heat-balance closure.
